components.name: System prerequisites
notes: Certificates, download and extraction tools, compilers or Python that the chosen installers need.

components.name: System package manager
notes: Record the real manager (winget, Homebrew, apt, dnf) and its version.

components.name: GitHub CLI
notes: Needed for PR and CI playbooks. Authenticate through the CLI; never record tokens.

components.name: Node version manager
notes: fnm is the default; record the real tool if another one is used.

components.name: Node.js LTS (>= 18)
notes: poteto-harness scripts need Node 18 or newer and no npm packages.

components.name: pnpm
notes: Only when a project uses pnpm. Prefer the version pinned by the project's packageManager field.

components.name: Docker client and engine
notes: Needed for a local PostgreSQL or other services in containers.

components.name: Claude Code CLI
notes: Record the version and whether it loads ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md with the poteto-harness block.

components.name: Codex CLI
notes: Record the version and whether it loads ~/.codex/AGENTS.md with the poteto-harness block.

components.name: Cursor
notes: Record whether .cursor/rules/poteto-harness.mdc is listed as an always-applied rule in a new chat.

components.name: poteto-harness
notes: Record the install mode (global or project), the harness home, and the result of validate-project.mjs.

components.name: Context7 MCP
notes: Remote MCP server: record the URL, the client config file, and one real query. There is no local package version.

components.name: Graphify (package: graphifyy)
notes: Record the executable path and one code-only extraction with no model call.

components.name: RTK
notes: Record the binary, the active hook (native or the harness template, never both) and one rewritten command.

components.name: ESLint quality rules
notes: Per project: eslint.config.mjs, eslint-rules/index.cjs and the self-check result.

components.name: Browser automation for live checks
notes: Only when a project's Feature Map needs a browser surface. Record the tool actually installed.

components.name: External skills and plugins
notes: One entry per installed external skill: source, revision, scan result, approval, and discovery check.

agent_clients.permission_mode: as authorized by the user; record the effective value, never loosen it to make a tool work
